Strictly higher-weight dependence in increments of dimensions and width logarithms, fixed depth D, root loss includes all incoming Q_i. Starting no slots gives polynomial envelopes; T=O_k(p), a0=alpha/2; density threshold>=1 impossible.

Mask W restricts x_j/P_j in (1/4,1/3),d_j/P_j in (1/(20k),1/(10k)); AP has no wrap and d nonzero.
